package.description: Editor for email filter Sieve scripts

en-US.description: Editor for email filter Sieve scripts
en-US.longDescription:
SieveEditor is a standalone editor for Sieve scripts, the server-side email filtering language defined by RFC 5228.
It connects to a mail server over ManageSieve, lists the scripts stored there, and lets you create, edit, activate, deactivate, debug and check the syntax of them, either through a graphical script builder or by editing the Sieve source directly.
en-US.name: pim-sieve-editor
